AAP Leader Priyanka Kakkar Joins Congress

Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) leader Priyanka Kakkar has joined the Congress party. Upon joining, Kakkar stated that those who spoke of leaving bungalows and cars have now started acquiring helicopters. This move comes ahead of the Punjab elections.
